title: Three ways to say a train is late
lede: All three render the same five departures, so the only thing that varies is the sentence. The row to watch is Eastbourne — it has no update at all, and a voice that reads well for a known nine-minute delay can quietly start inventing numbers for the case where nothing is known.

sections.title: The three voices
sections.note: Each is a different structural bet about what the board owes you: the fact, the answer, or the size of the problem.
